result.decision: retain the shared anisotropic Gaussian-shaped Poisson field for physical-domain and severe-artifact integration testing
result.reason: the label-blind development selection improves held-scan median NPS distance by 85.45%, reduces worst distance to 22.09% of the P4D isotropic baseline, beats the reversed-frequency control, and preserves exact repeat/row partitions and nonnegative fields

interpretation: The selected vertical/horizontal width difference is consistent with a scanner or scan-processing anisotropy and must remain a generic scanner-convolved output-profile hypothesis.
The evidence does not identify Ektar100 or UltraMax400 emulsion structure and does not estimate physical grain size.
NPS-shape improvement alone is insufficient for integration; ACF, density/transmittance semantics and severe visual artifacts remain prospective gates.
claim_ceiling: Held-scan generic scanner-convolved NPS-shape development evidence for one bounded anisotropic Poisson candidate; not emulsion truth, physical grain calibration, stock identity, scanner independence or product promotion.
